COMMAND_INVALID.remediation: Send one published Venue command with its required fields.

COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Refresh the command contract and use a published command type.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.message: Idempotency key is required for mutating commands.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.remediation: Retry with one stable idempotency key for this semantic action.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.remediation: Use the original command input or generate a new idempotency key.

SNAPSHOT_INVALID.remediation: Restore a canonical Project schema 10 snapshot containing a Plan, Proposal, and Activity Ledger.

PROPOSAL_NOT_REVIEWABLE.message: Only a Proposal under review can be changed.
PROPOSAL_NOT_REVIEWABLE.remediation: Create or activate a Proposal with review status before changing it.

PROPOSAL_MISMATCH.message: Proposal ID does not match the active Proposal.
PROPOSAL_MISMATCH.remediation: Inspect the active Proposal and retry with its stable ID.

PROPOSAL_EMPTY.remediation: Keep accepted truth unchanged; create a Proposal only after at least one planning Change exists.

PLANNING_EFFECT_INVALID.remediation: Restore a snapshot whose active and historical Proposal Changes conform to the published Planning Effect schema.

BRANCH_NOT_FOUND.remediation: List Proposal Branches and retry with an existing stable Branch ID.

REBASE_CONFLICT.remediation: Resolve blocking conflicts, then retry the rebase.

CONFLICT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Detect current Proposal conflicts and retry with a stable conflict ID.

CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_INVALID.message: Conflict resolution is not valid for this conflict.
CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_INVALID.remediation: Choose one of the conflict's published resolution options.

CONFLICT_HUMAN_REQUIRED.message: Only a human can resolve a Proposal conflict.
CONFLICT_HUMAN_REQUIRED.remediation: Ask an authorized human operator to choose a conflict outcome in VenueMind Studio.

LOCK_CONFLICT.message: Proposal Change conflicts with an active Lock.
LOCK_CONFLICT.remediation: Remove the locked property mutation or have a human release the applicable Project Lock.

LOCK_HUMAN_REQUIRED.message: Only a human can manage Project Locks.
LOCK_HUMAN_REQUIRED.remediation: Ask an authorized human operator to add or release the Project Lock.

LOCK_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect stable object IDs and retry with an object in the active Plan.

LOCK_TYPE_INVALID.remediation: Use position, rotation, dimension, deletion, or role.

LOCK_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect Project Locks and retry with an active stable Lock ID.

PLAN_VERSION_CONFLICT.remediation: Inspect the latest Plan Version and create or rebase the Proposal before retrying.

OPERATIONAL_RESOURCE_FRESHNESS_REQUIRED.message: Operational resource freshness proof is required.
OPERATIONAL_RESOURCE_FRESHNESS_REQUIRED.remediation: Resolve the latest trusted operational-resource snapshot for this Project before approving the Proposal.

OPERATIONAL_RESOURCE_STALE.remediation: Refresh operational resources, rebuild the substitution Proposal, and validate it again.

VALIDATION_FAILED.remediation: Resolve every hard Constraint failure and validate again.

WARNING_WAIVER_REQUIRED.message: Proposal has warnings that require a human Warning Waiver.
WARNING_WAIVER_REQUIRED.remediation: Have a human record a reason-coded waiver for every open warning.

EMERGENCY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.message: Emergency Plan Change requires an authorized human Emergency Review.
EMERGENCY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.remediation: Supply a reviewer ID, authorized reviewer role, and explicit assumption acceptance in VenueMind Studio.

EMERGENCY_REVIEW_UNAUTHORIZED.message: Emergency reviewer role is not authorized.
EMERGENCY_REVIEW_UNAUTHORIZED.remediation: Use a reviewer assigned to one of the Emergency Plan's authorized reviewer roles.

WAIVER_HUMAN_REQUIRED.message: Only a human can create a Warning Waiver.
WAIVER_HUMAN_REQUIRED.remediation: Ask an authorized human operator to record the disposition in VenueMind Studio.

WAIVER_AUTHOR_REQUIRED.message: Warning Waiver requires an author ID.
WAIVER_AUTHOR_REQUIRED.remediation: Supply the authenticated or local operator identity.

WAIVER_REASON_INVALID.message: Warning Waiver requires a supported reason code.
WAIVER_REASON_INVALID.remediation: Choose one reason code from the Warning Waiver contract.

WARNING_NOT_WAIVABLE.message: Constraint does not have a waivable warning.
WARNING_NOT_WAIVABLE.remediation: Validate again and select an open warning Constraint.

WARNING_ALREADY_WAIVED.remediation: Use the existing Warning Waiver or revise the Proposal before recording another disposition.

CONSTRAINT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect the Plan and retry with an existing stable Constraint ID.

CONSTRAINT_INVALID.remediation: Conform the Constraint to the published schema and retry.

CONSTRAINT_DUPLICATE.remediation: Assign a unique stable ID to every Constraint.

CONSTRAINT_EVIDENCE_INVALID.remediation: Provide numeric evidence and threshold values required by the evaluator.

CONSTRAINT_EVALUATOR_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Use an evaluator published in the Venue Constraint schema.

GEOMETRY_INVALID.remediation: Correct the reported boundary, Footprint, unit, or operational metadata and validate again.

SPATIAL_CHANGE_TARGET_MISSING.message: Spatial Change targets a missing object.
SPATIAL_CHANGE_TARGET_MISSING.remediation: Inspect stable object IDs and rebuild the Change against the active Plan.

SPATIAL_CHANGE_TARGET_EXISTS.message: Spatial Change would reuse an existing object ID.
SPATIAL_CHANGE_TARGET_EXISTS.remediation: Create a new Project-scoped stable object ID and retry the placement.

SPATIAL_CHANGE_UNSUPPORTED.message: Spatial Change operation is not supported.
SPATIAL_CHANGE_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Use a published spatial Change operation.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.remediation: List the template catalog and select a published template ID and version.

TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.message: Template schema version is not supported.
TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Migrate the template document with a published migration path.

TEMPLATE_BINDING_NOT_FOUND.message: Project is not bound to this template.
TEMPLATE_BINDING_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect the Project Template Binding and retry with its Room Template ID.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_CURRENT.message: Project already uses this template version.
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CURRENT.remediation: Select a newer published Room Template version.

COMMENT_INVALID.remediation: Provide a non-empty comment body, supported status, and published fields.

COMMENT_ANCHOR_INVALID.message: Comment anchor does not resolve to an immutable VenueMind subject.
COMMENT_ANCHOR_INVALID.remediation: Inspect stable Project, Plan Version, Proposal, Change, Constraint, or coordinate identifiers and retry.

COMMENT_AUTHOR_REQUIRED.message: Comment action requires an author ID.
COMMENT_AUTHOR_REQUIRED.remediation: Supply the authenticated or local author identity.

COMMENT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: List comments and retry with an existing stable Comment ID.

PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: List Projects and retry with an existing stable Project ID.

PROJECT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.message: Project tools are unavailable in this session.
PROJECT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Open VenueMind from a Project-aware host and retry the Project operation.

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Search objects and retry with an existing stable object ID.

VALIDATION_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Validate the current Proposal and retry with its Validation ID.

SCENARIO_RUN_NOT_FOUND.remediation: List Scenario Runs and retry with an existing stable Run ID.

TOOL_SCOPE_REQUIRED.remediation: Grant the published scope for this tool or use a read-only tool within the current session.

AUTHORIZATION_DENIED.message: The current principal is not authorized for this VenueMind action.
AUTHORIZATION_DENIED.remediation: Use an assigned Organization Membership Role or an active Organization- and Project-scoped Agent Grant containing the required permission.

AGENT_GRANT_INVALID.remediation: Issue a complete Organization- and Project-scoped grant with published scopes and a lifetime of one hour or less.

TOOL_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.message: Tool payload exceeds its published size limit.
TOOL_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.remediation: Reduce the requested geometry or export payload and retry within the published byte limit.

TOOL_CALL_CANCELLED.remediation: Retry only if the caller still needs the operation, using the same idempotency key for an interrupted mutation.

LEDGER_INTEGRITY_FAILED.remediation: Restore an untampered snapshot or recover the last verified Project record.

RUNBOOK_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED.message: Event Day Runbook requires an accepted canonical schedule.
RUNBOOK_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED.remediation: Set and approve an Event Brief schedule with canonical start, end, and timezone values.

RUNBOOK_DEFINITION_INVALID.message: Event Day Runbook definition is invalid.
RUNBOOK_DEFINITION_INVALID.remediation: Correct the reported phase, task, owner, dependency, or accepted-source reference.

RUNBOOK_TASK_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect the active Runbook Version and retry with a stable task ID.

RUNBOOK_TASK_REVISION_CONFLICT.remediation: Refresh the task projection, review the accepted transition, and retry only if another transition is still required.

RUNBOOK_TRANSITION_INVALID.remediation: Use a published task transition and supply a reason-coded human reopen for terminal work.

RUNBOOK_DEPENDENCIES_INCOMPLETE.remediation: Complete every dependency before starting this task.

RUNBOOK_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.remediation: Attach every required structured evidence code before completing the task.

OCCUPANCY_BASELINE_INVALID.remediation: Create the monitor from one active Event Day Runbook with canonical Plan capacity and event-target evidence.

OCCUPANCY_SIGNAL_INVALID.remediation: Send one bounded aggregate-only signal for the check-in total, venue, or a stable Occupancy Zone.

OCCUPANCY_PRIVACY_REJECTED.message: Occupancy input contains prohibited person-level data.
OCCUPANCY_PRIVACY_REJECTED.remediation: Remove identities, contacts, ticket tokens, device identifiers, and individual event records before ingestion.

OCCUPANCY_SIGNAL_OUT_OF_ORDER.message: Occupancy Signal is older than the accepted source state.
OCCUPANCY_SIGNAL_OUT_OF_ORDER.remediation: Refresh the source cursor and send a newer source version and observed instant.

OCCUPANCY_REVISION_CONFLICT.remediation: Refresh the monitor and retry only if the aggregate transition is still required.

OCCUPANCY_ALERT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Refresh the Live Occupancy Monitor and select an active Alert ID.

OCCUPANCY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_INVALID.remediation: Use an authenticated human operator, an active Alert ID, and one structured reason code.

OCCUPANCY_LEDGER_INTEGRITY_FAILED.remediation: Restore the last verified monitor state before inspection or export.

OCCUPANCY_MONITOR_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Create the monitor from the active Event Day Runbook before inspecting or changing occupancy.

OCCUPANCY_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.message: Live Occupancy tool Adapter is unavailable.
OCCUPANCY_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Open VenueMind Studio or connect an MCP Project session with Live Occupancy operations enabled.

INCIDENT_BASELINE_INVALID.remediation: Create the register from one active Event Day Runbook with its frozen accepted Plan and Emergency Plan evidence.

INCIDENT_REGISTER_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Create the register from the active Event Day Runbook before inspecting or reporting incidents.

INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Inspect the Incident Register and retry with an existing stable Incident ID.

INCIDENT_ID_CONFLICT.message: Operational Incident ID conflicts with an existing record.
INCIDENT_ID_CONFLICT.remediation: Use the original semantic report or generate a new stable Incident ID.

INCIDENT_INVALID.remediation: Use the published severity, category, owner, reason, reference, and transition fields.

INCIDENT_PRIVACY_REJECTED.message: Incident input contains prohibited person-level data.
INCIDENT_PRIVACY_REJECTED.remediation: Remove identities, contacts, ticket, device, attendee, medical, and free-form person records.

INCIDENT_LOCATION_INVALID.remediation: Anchor the incident to one object or in-room coordinate in the frozen accepted Plan.

INCIDENT_REVISION_CONFLICT.remediation: Refresh the incident and retry only if the transition is still required.

INCIDENT_TRANSITION_INVALID.remediation: Use a published state transition and supply any required structured reason or resolution code.

INCIDENT_OWNER_INVALID.remediation: Assign one structured Runbook role, shift, Staff Post, or assignment reference.

INCIDENT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_INVALID.remediation: Use an authenticated human operator and an unacknowledged open incident.

INCIDENT_ESCALATION_INVALID.remediation: Increase the structured escalation level without skipping required authority.

INCIDENT_HANDOFF_INVALID.remediation: Use the current owner, a different structured next owner, and bounded open action codes.

INCIDENT_EMERGENCY_ACTION_INVALID.remediation: Use an approved action, scenario, and object reference from the frozen Emergency Plan.

INCIDENT_HUMAN_REQUIRED.message: This Incident transition requires a human operator.
INCIDENT_HUMAN_REQUIRED.remediation: Ask an authorized human operator to acknowledge, manage, hand off, or record an emergency action.

INCIDENT_LEDGER_INTEGRITY_FAILED.remediation: Restore the last verified register state before inspection or export.

INCIDENT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Open VenueMind Studio or connect an MCP Project session with Incident Register operations enabled.

VENUE_INTERNAL_ERROR.message: VenueMind could not complete the operation.
VENUE_INTERNAL_ERROR.remediation: Retry once; if the error persists, inspect the server log with the correlation ID.
